// ブックマークレット
// 以下のコードをブラウザのブックマークURLとして登録してください

javascript:(function(){var HeadingDetector={config:{fontSizeRatio:1.15,boldThreshold:600,maxTextLength:150,maxHeadings:100,highlightColors:{h1:'rgba(255,107,107,0.3)',h2:'rgba(255,159,67,0.3)',h3:'rgba(255,220,0,0.3)',h4:'rgba(72,219,251,0.3)',h5:'rgba(162,155,254,0.3)',h6:'rgba(200,200,200,0.3)'}},getBaseFontSize:function(){var b=document.body;if(!b)return 16;var c=window.getComputedStyle(b);return parseFloat(c.fontSize)||16},isHeadingCandidate:function(e,baseFontSize){if(e.offsetParent===null&&e.tagName!=='BODY')return null;var s=window.getComputedStyle(e),fontSize=parseFloat(s.fontSize),fontWeight=parseInt(s.fontWeight)||400,display=s.display,text=e.textContent.trim();if(!text||text.length>this.config.maxTextLength||text.length<2)return null;if(e.children.length>5)return null;var isBigger=fontSize>=baseFontSize*this.config.fontSizeRatio,isBold=fontWeight>=this.config.boldThreshold,isBlock=['block','flex','grid','list-item'].includes(display)||display.startsWith('table'),score=0,level=6;if(isBigger){score+=30;var ratio=fontSize/baseFontSize;if(ratio>=2.0)level=1;else if(ratio>=1.6)level=2;else if(ratio>=1.3)level=3;else if(ratio>=1.15)level=4;else level=5}if(isBold){score+=25;if(level>3)level=Math.max(level-1,1)}if(isBlock)score+=15;var mt=parseFloat(s.marginTop)||0,mb=parseFloat(s.marginBottom)||0,pt=parseFloat(s.paddingTop)||0,pb=parseFloat(s.paddingBottom)||0;if(mt>10||pt>10)score+=10;if(mb>5||pb>5)score+=5;if(text.length<=50)score+=10;if(text.length<=20)score+=5;var ci=(e.className+' '+e.id).toLowerCase();if(/heading|title|header|section-title|headline/i.test(ci))score+=15;if(score<40)return null;return{element:e,text:text.substring(0,100),level:level,score:score}},removeDuplicates:function(headings){var result=[],elements=headings.map(function(h){return h.element});for(var i=0;i<headings.length;i++){var heading=headings[i],isDuplicate=false;for(var j=0;j<elements.length;j++){var other=elements[j];if(heading.element===other)continue;if(heading.element.contains(other)||other.contains(heading.element)){var otherHeading=headings.find(function(h){return h.element===other});if(other.contains(heading.element)&&otherHeading.score>=heading.score){isDuplicate=true;break}}}if(!isDuplicate)result.push(heading)}return result},detect:function(){var baseFontSize=this.getBaseFontSize();var existingHeadings=document.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6');var candidates=[];var elements=document.querySelectorAll('p,div,span,li,td,th,a,strong,b,em,article,section,header,footer,main,aside,nav,label');for(var i=0;i<elements.length;i++){var element=elements[i];var isInsideHeading=false;for(var j=0;j<existingHeadings.length;j++){if(existingHeadings[j].contains(element)){isInsideHeading=true;break}}if(isInsideHeading)continue;var result=this.isHeadingCandidate(element,baseFontSize);if(result)candidates.push(result)}candidates.sort(function(a,b){return b.score-a.score});var filtered=this.removeDuplicates(candidates.slice(0,200));filtered.sort(function(a,b){var pos=a.element.compareDocumentPosition(b.element);return pos&Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING?-1:1});var allHeadings=[];for(var i=0;i<existingHeadings.length;i++){var h=existingHeadings[i];var text=h.textContent.trim();if(text)allHeadings.push({element:h,text:text.substring(0,100),level:parseInt(h.tagName.charAt(1)),score:100,isNative:true})}for(var i=0;i<Math.min(filtered.length,100);i++){filtered[i].isNative=false;allHeadings.push(filtered[i])}allHeadings.sort(function(a,b){var pos=a.element.compareDocumentPosition(b.element);return pos&Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING?-1:1});return allHeadings},highlight:function(headings){this.clearHighlight();for(var i=0;i<headings.length;i++){var heading=headings[i];var el=heading.element;var level='h'+heading.level;var color=this.config.highlightColors[level]||this.config.highlightColors.h6;el.style.outline='2px solid '+color.replace('0.3','0.8');el.style.backgroundColor=color;el.dataset.headingDetected='true'}},clearHighlight:function(){var highlighted=document.querySelectorAll('[data-heading-detected="true"]');for(var i=0;i<highlighted.length;i++){var el=highlighted[i];el.style.outline='';el.style.backgroundColor='';delete el.dataset.headingDetected}},run:function(){var headings=this.detect();this.highlight(headings);console.group('🔍 Heading Detector');console.log('検出数: '+headings.length);for(var i=0;i<headings.length;i++){var h=headings[i];console.log((h.isNative?'📌':'✨')+' [H'+h.level+'] "'+h.text+'"',h.element)}console.groupEnd();return headings}};var h=HeadingDetector.run();alert('🔍 見出し検出完了!\n\n検出数: '+h.length+' 件\n\n詳細はコンソール (F12) を確認してください。')})();
